Updated on Jul 22, 2026 This section covers requirements for all ads. Additional country-specific and supply-specific restrictions may apply. Advertisers are required to: Comply with all applicable local laws and regulations. Include legible disclosures as required by law. Ensure that ad content is accurate. Ensure that AI-generated content doesn't mislead customers. This includes photorealistic but inaccurate depictions, or content that mimics real people without consent. Failure to comply may result in ads being paused, removed, or restricted. Identify themselves and the product or service being promoted in the ad creative. Accurately declare their category upon campaign set-up. Comply with Brand Usage Guidelines if referencing Amazon, its products, or programs. Advertisers must not use unauthorized content that uses "Amazon's Choice," "Best Seller" rankings, or altered Amazon logos. Refrain from misusing or manipulating Amazon Ads products. Ensure that ads are appropriate for the intended audience. Amazon doesn't promote self-harm or permit products or media to be advertised that glorify, depict or advocate for self-harm (including suicide, eating disorders, and self-injury). Ensure the accuracy of claims and provide factual substantiation if requested by Amazon. To review the full policy, visit Claims and Substantiation . Obtain and maintain all necessary rights and permissions for all content in ads, such as logos, music, images, and others. Comply with Open Internet supplier policies . Amazon respects all Open Internet supply source block requests. Advertisers are responsible for ensuring their promotions comply with applicable laws and regulations. All ads must clearly indicate that terms and conditions apply and make it easy for customers to understand where those terms can be found. Advertisers must comply with all applicable local laws and regulations governing advertising to children. Amazon reserves the right to pause or remove ads at any time based on customer feedback. It also reserves the right to remove content that attempts to trick or circumvent our ad review processes. Ads that refer to Amazon, its businesses, or people associated with them may be declined.
